name: Flame of the Dawn
body:
You have been raised to view yourself as a blade in the service of the Goddess of the Sun, or you have taken on that duty for yourself.

Benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit with a scimitar, you deal 2 additional points of fire damage to your target.
